diagrams.title: OIDC endpoint diagnostic flow
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart LR
  endpoint["GitHub Actions OIDC request endpoint"] --> classify["Classify with fixed booleans"]
  classify --> report["Emit no URL path query token or userinfo values"]
  report --> stop["Stop before OIDC request"]
  stop --> evidence["Use observed predicate in the follow-up fix"]

diagrams.title: OIDC diagnostic data boundary
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  endpoint["Runner endpoint"] --> classifier["Existing predicate observations"]
  classifier --> safe["Fixed booleans only"]
  endpoint --> secret["URL path query token and userinfo values"]
  secret --> blocked["Never logged"]
  safe --> stop["Dedicated error before request"]
  stop --> followup["Evidence-bound correction"]

diagrams.title: OIDC publication correction state
diagrams.mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> DiagnosticEvidenceRecorded
  DiagnosticEvidenceRecorded --> HostnameBoundaryCorrected
  HostnameBoundaryCorrected --> DiagnosticFlagRemoved
  DiagnosticFlagRemoved --> PublicationRetried
  PublicationRetried --> RegistryVerified
  RegistryVerified --> [*]
